---
title: "Nowcast Evaluation: `r params$nowcast_name %||% params$nowcast_source`"
subtitle: "Artifact `r params$artifact_id`"
author: "Delphi Group"
date: today
format:
  html:
    code-fold: true
    toc: true
    toc-depth: 3
    number-sections: true
    embed-resources: true
params:
  # Nowcast to evaluate: an Epidata V5 /nowcast/ source and one of its served
  # artifacts. The artifact fixes the model, its params and the signal.
  # fetch_served_artifacts() in R/nowcast_api.R lists the served artifacts.
  nowcast_source:
  artifact_id:
  nowcast_name:
  geo_type: state
  # Finalized guiding indicator for the correlation lift. Leave empty for WIS only.
  guiding_source:
  guiding_signal:
  guiding_name:
  # Forecast dates (Wednesdays) to evaluate. Default: first nowcast run to today.
  start_day:
  end_day:
  # Days from the forecast Wednesday to the data cutoff. Default: -1 (Tuesday)
  # for claims, which release after forecasts are made, 0 otherwise.
  report_offset_days: !expr "NULL"
  # Lags to score, in the nowcast's time unit. Default: daily nowcasts use
  # 0-7 days then weekly to ref_lag; weekly nowcasts use every lag.
  wis_lags: !expr "NULL"
  # Weeks between the candidate week and the anchor week of the guide.
  correlation_lags_weeks: !expr "0:4"
  # Reference times this close to the latest version may still be revised,
  # so they are not used as truth.
  truth_buffer_days: 182
  # Minimum forecast dates for a per-geo correlation.
  min_points_per_geo: 20
  # Geos for the example plots.
  example_geos: !expr 'c("ca", "ny", "pa", "tx")'
  # Keep API results on disk between renders.
  use_cache: true
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    comment: "#>"
    message: FALSE
    warning: FALSE
    out.width: "100%"
    dev: "png"
    fig.width: 9
    fig.height: 5
    fig.align: center
editor_options:
  chunk_output_type: console
execute:
  cache: false
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
if (!exists("params")) {
    params <- list(
        nowcast_source = "claims_outpatient",
        artifact_id = "bde3aa63cb72cca5",
        nowcast_name = "Claims: % Outpatient Visits COVID",
        geo_type = "state",
        guiding_source = "nhsn",
        guiding_signal = "confirmed_admissions_covid_ew",
        guiding_name = "NHSN: Confirmed COVID Admissions",
        start_day = "2024-11-01",
        end_day = NULL,
        report_offset_days = NULL,
        wis_lags = NULL,
        correlation_lags_weeks = 0:4,
        truth_buffer_days = 182,
        min_points_per_geo = 20,
        example_geos = c("ca", "ny", "pa", "tx"),
        use_cache = TRUE
    )
}

if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
min_versions <- c(epidatr = "1.4.0", epiprocess = "0.13.0")
for (pkg in names(min_versions)) {
    if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE) || packageVersion(pkg) < min_versions[[pkg]]) {
        pak::pkg_install(paste0("cmu-delphi/", pkg, "@dev"))
    }
}
if (!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(epidatr, epiprocess, httr2, DT, tidyverse, scales, ggtext, glue, here)

for (path in list.files(here::here("nowcast_analysis", "R"), pattern = "\\.R$", full.names = TRUE)) {
    source(path)
}
set_rat_scan_theme()

guiding_name <- params$guiding_name %||% params$guiding_signal
has_guide <- !is.null(params$guiding_source) && nzchar(params$guiding_source)

cache_dir <- here::here("nowcast_analysis", "nowcast_evaluation_cache")
dir.create(cache_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
cached <- function(name, expr) {
    path <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0(name, "_", rlang::hash(params), ".rds"))
    if (params$use_cache && file.exists(path)) {
        return(readRDS(path))
    }
    value <- expr
    saveRDS(value, path)
    value
}
```

This notebook evaluates a **nowcast** as it would have been used on forecast day.
Forecasts are made on Wednesdays, so each Wednesday has a data cutoff: the latest release available before forecasts are made.
At each cutoff, the nowcast is compared with the **as-of value**, the latest reported value a forecaster would have used without it.

Two questions are asked:

1. Is the nowcast closer to the finalized value than the as-of value? This uses the weighted interval score (WIS), as in the epidata-etl nowcast evaluation.
2. Does the nowcast track a finalized guiding indicator better than the as-of value does? This is the RAT-scan correlation analysis, run once on the nowcast and once on the as-of data.

## Configuration {#config}

```{r}
#| label: metadata
if (!grepl("^[0-9a-f]{16}$", params$artifact_id %||% "")) {
    served <- fetch_served_artifacts(params$nowcast_source)
    cli::cli_abort(c(
        "{.arg artifact_id} must be one 16-character artifact ID, not {.val {params$artifact_id %||% 'empty'}}.",
        "i" = "Served artifacts of {params$nowcast_source}: {.val {paste(served$signal, served$artifact_id)}}."
    ))
}
artifact <- fetch_nowcast_metadata(params$nowcast_source, artifact_id = params$artifact_id)
if (nrow(artifact) != 1) {
    cli::cli_abort("Artifact {.val {params$artifact_id}} is not a nowcast artifact of {params$nowcast_source}.")
}
nowcast_signal <- artifact$signal
nowcast_name <- params$nowcast_name %||% nowcast_signal
model_params <- artifact$params[[1]]
weekly <- identical(model_params$temporal_resol, "weekly")
lag_unit <- if (weekly) "weeks" else "days"
ref_lag <- model_params$ref_lag
exclusions <- exclusions_from_params(model_params)

report_offset_days <- params$report_offset_days %||% default_report_offset(params$nowcast_source)
start_day <- as.Date(params$start_day %||% artifact$first_train_data)
end_day <- as.Date(params$end_day %||% Sys.Date())
cutoffs <- forecast_cutoffs(start_day, end_day, report_offset_days)

anchor_lags <- if (has_guide) params$correlation_lags_weeks else integer()
wis_lags <- params$wis_lags %||% if (weekly) NULL else default_daily_lags(ref_lag)
fetch_horizons <- if (weekly) NULL else -sort(unique(c(
    wis_lags, anchor_lags_days(wday0(cutoffs$cutoff[1]), anchor_lags)
)))

config_tbl <- tibble(
    Item = c(
        "Nowcast", "Artifact", "Time unit", "Reference lag (ref_lag)", "Guiding indicator",
        "Forecast dates", "Data cutoff", "Truth buffer"
    ),
    Value = c(
        glue("{nowcast_name} ({params$nowcast_source} / {nowcast_signal}, {params$geo_type})"),
        glue("{artifact$nowcaster} {artifact$artifact_id}: {artifact$run_count} runs, data to {artifact$latest_train_data}"),
        lag_unit,
        glue("{ref_lag} days"),
        if (has_guide) glue("{guiding_name} ({params$guiding_source} / {params$guiding_signal}), finalized") else "none",
        glue("{nrow(cutoffs)} Wednesdays, {min(cutoffs$forecast_date)} to {max(cutoffs$forecast_date)}"),
        if (report_offset_days == 0) "the forecast Wednesday" else glue("{weekdays(cutoffs$cutoff[1])}, {abs(report_offset_days)} day(s) before each forecast Wednesday"),
        glue("{params$truth_buffer_days} days")
    )
)
DT::datatable(config_tbl, rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", ordering = FALSE))
```

The parameters of artifact `r params$artifact_id`, as stored in the nowcast registry.

if (nrow(exclusions) > 0) {
    cat("Rows with a report or reference time in these training exclusion windows of the artifact are not scored:\n\n")
    exclusions |>
        mutate(geos = map_chr(geo_values, \(geos) if (length(geos) == 0) "all" else paste(geos, collapse = ", "))) |>

## Data {#data}

```{r}
#| label: load-nowcasts
#| output: asis
nowcasts <- cached("nowcasts", fetch_nowcast_archive(
    params$nowcast_source, nowcast_signal, params$geo_type, artifact$artifact_id,
    report_dates = cutoffs$cutoff, horizons = fetch_horizons, weekly = weekly
)) |>
    inner_join(cutoffs, by = c("report_time" = "cutoff")) |>
    mutate(cutoff = report_time)

cutoffs_with_run <- n_distinct(nowcasts$cutoff)
cat(glue(
    "- **Nowcast runs**: {cutoffs_with_run} of {nrow(cutoffs)} cutoffs have a run on the cutoff date ",
    "({label_comma()(nrow(nowcasts))} quantile rows, {n_distinct(nowcasts$geo_value)} geos)."
), "\n")
if (cutoffs_with_run < nrow(cutoffs)) {
    missing_cutoffs <- setdiff(cutoffs$cutoff, nowcasts$cutoff) |> as.Date()
    cat(glue(
        "- Cutoffs without a run are not evaluated. The first few: {paste(head(sort(missing_cutoffs), 5), collapse = ', ')}."
    ), "\n")
}
if (cutoffs_with_run == 0) {
    cli::cli_abort("No nowcast run falls on a cutoff date. Check {.arg report_offset_days} against the run schedule.")
}
```

```{r}
#| label: load-as-of
#| output: asis
nowcast_keys <- nowcasts |> distinct(forecast_date, cutoff, geo_value, reference_time, lag)
max_fill_days <- 60L
v5_rows <- cached("candidate_archive", epidata_archive(
    params$nowcast_source, nowcast_signal, params$geo_type,
    reference_time = epirange(min(nowcast_keys$reference_time) - max_fill_days, max(nowcast_keys$reference_time))
))
candidate_archive <- archive_from_v5(v5_rows)
rm(v5_rows)

as_of <- cached("as_of", as_of_values(candidate_archive, nowcast_keys, max_fill_days))
truth <- final_values(candidate_archive, params$truth_buffer_days)

cat(glue(
    "- **As-of data**: {label_comma()(nrow(candidate_archive$DT))} archive rows, versions to {candidate_archive$versions_end}."
), "\n")
cat(glue(
    "- **Truth**: finalized values up to {max(truth$reference_time)}, ",
    "{params$truth_buffer_days} days before the latest version."
), "\n")
```

```{r}
#| label: score
model_scores <- nowcasts |>
    inner_join(truth, by = c("geo_value", "reference_time")) |>
    apply_exclusions(exclusions, params$geo_type) |>
    score_quantiles(c("forecast_date", "cutoff", "geo_value", "reference_time", "lag"))

scores <- model_scores |>
    inner_join(as_of, by = c("forecast_date", "cutoff", "geo_value", "reference_time", "lag")) |>
    filter(!is.na(as_of_value)) |>
    mutate(score_point(as_of_value, true_value))

if (!is.null(wis_lags)) {
    scores <- filter(scores, lag %in% wis_lags)
}
scored_lags <- sort(unique(scores$lag))
lag_label <- function(lags, levels = scored_lags) factor(paste("lag", lags), levels = paste("lag", levels))
# Rows for every forecast date, so that lines break where dates have no data.
complete_dates <- function(rows, ...) tidyr::complete(rows, forecast_date = cutoffs$forecast_date, ...)
```

## Nowcasts against the as-of and finalized values {#overview}

Each panel shows, for one geo and lag, the nowcast at every cutoff: its median and its 80% interval.
The as-of value is the latest reported value at the cutoff, filled forward when the reference time has no value yet.
The finalized line is the latest value; it stops `r params$truth_buffer_days` days before the latest version.

```{r}
#| label: overview
#| fig-height: 8
overview_lags <- unique(c(min(scored_lags), scored_lags[which.min(abs(scored_lags - median(scored_lags)))]))
overview_geos <- intersect(params$example_geos, unique(nowcasts$geo_value))

overview_bands <- nowcasts |>
    filter(geo_value %in% overview_geos, lag %in% overview_lags, quantile_level %in% c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9)) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = quantile_level, values_from = value, names_prefix = "q") |>
    left_join(as_of, by = c("forecast_date", "cutoff", "geo_value", "reference_time", "lag")) |>
    group_by(geo_value, lag) |>
    tidyr::complete(reference_time = seq(min(reference_time), max(reference_time), by = "week")) |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(lag = lag_label(lag, overview_lags))
overview_final <- truth |>
    filter(geo_value %in% overview_geos, reference_time >= min(overview_bands$reference_time))

ggplot(overview_bands, aes(x = reference_time)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q0.1, ymax = q0.9), fill = version_colours[["nowcast"]], alpha = 0.2) +
    geom_line(data = tidyr::crossing(overview_final, lag = unique(overview_bands$lag)),
              aes(y = true_value, colour = "final"), linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_line(aes(y = as_of_value, colour = "as_of"), linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_line(aes(y = q0.5, colour = "nowcast"), linewidth = 0.6) +
    facet_grid(geo_value ~ lag, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = version_colours, labels = version_labels, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_date(breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 4), labels = label_date_short()) +
    labs(x = "Reference date", y = nowcast_signal,
         title = glue("{nowcast_name}: nowcast at each cutoff"))
```

## Weighted interval score {#wis}

WIS is the mean over the stored quantile levels of 2 × the pinball loss, as in `compute_scores.sql` of epidata-etl.
The as-of value is a point forecast, so its WIS is its absolute error.
The relative WIS is the sum of nowcast WIS over the sum of as-of WIS on the same rows: below 1, the nowcast is better than using the data as reported.
Log WIS is the same on `log(x + 1)`, which weights each geo by its relative error instead of its size.

### By lag

```{r}
#| label: wis-by-lag
rel_by_lag <- relative_scores(scores, "lag") |> arrange(lag)

rel_by_lag |>
    pivot_longer(c(rel_wis, rel_log_wis), names_to = "metric", values_to = "relative") |>
    mutate(metric = recode(metric, rel_wis = "Relative WIS", rel_log_wis = "Relative log WIS")) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = lag, y = relative, colour = metric)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray50") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = unname(version_colours[c("nowcast", "as_of")]), name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA)) +
    labs(x = glue("Lag from cutoff ({lag_unit})"), y = "Nowcast / as-of",
         title = "Relative WIS by lag", subtitle = "Below 1: the nowcast is better than the as-of value")
```

```{r}
#| label: wis-by-lag-table
rel_by_lag |>
    mutate(across(c(rel_wis, rel_log_wis), \(xx) round(xx, 3)), across(c(wis, null_wis), \(xx) signif(xx, 3))) |>
    select(lag, n, rel_wis, rel_log_wis, nowcast_wis = wis, as_of_wis = null_wis) |>
    DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, caption = glue("Lags in {lag_unit}; WIS columns are means"),
                  options = list(dom = "t", pageLength = 50, ordering = FALSE))
```

The as-of value at the shortest lags is often a filled-forward value, because the data for that reference time is not yet reported.
This share explains much of the gain at short lags:

```{r}
#| label: as-of-availability
#| fig-height: 3.5
scores |>
    summarize(filled = mean(!as_of_available), .by = lag) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = lag, y = filled)) +
    geom_col(fill = version_colours[["as_of"]], width = if (weekly) 0.6 else 0.8) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = glue("Lag from cutoff ({lag_unit})"), y = "Share filled forward",
         title = "As-of values with no report yet for their reference time")
```

### By geo

```{r}
#| label: wis-by-geo
#| fig-height: 9
rel_by_geo <- relative_scores(scores, c("geo_value", "lag"))
geo_order <- relative_scores(scores, "geo_value") |> arrange(rel_wis) |> pull(geo_value)

rel_by_geo |>
    mutate(geo_value = factor(geo_value, levels = geo_order), lag = lag_label(lag)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = lag, y = geo_value, fill = rel_wis)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_relative("Relative WIS") +
    labs(x = glue("Lag from cutoff ({lag_unit})"), y = NULL, title = "Relative WIS by geo and lag",
         subtitle = "Blue: nowcast better than the as-of value. Grey: both are exact. Geos sorted by overall relative WIS.") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank())
```

### Over time

```{r}
#| label: wis-over-time
#| fig-height: 6
time_lags <- overview_lags
relative_scores(filter(scores, lag %in% time_lags), c("forecast_date", "lag")) |>
    complete_dates(lag = time_lags) |>
    mutate(lag = lag_label(lag, time_lags)) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = forecast_date, y = rel_wis)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray50") +
    geom_line(colour = version_colours[["nowcast"]], linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_point(colour = version_colours[["nowcast"]], size = 1.5) +
    facet_wrap(~lag, ncol = 1) +
    scale_y_continuous(trans = "log2", labels = label_number(accuracy = 0.01)) +
    scale_x_date(breaks = breaks_pretty(), labels = label_date_short()) +
    labs(x = "Forecast date", y = "Relative WIS (log scale)",
         title = "Relative WIS at each forecast date", subtitle = "Pooled over geos; gaps are dates without a run or excluded")
```

### Interval coverage

The share of finalized values inside each central interval of the nowcast. A calibrated nowcast is on the dashed nominal line.

```{r}
#| label: coverage
#| fig-height: 4
coverage <- scores |>
    summarize(across(c(cover_60, cover_80, cover_90), \(xx) mean(xx, na.rm = TRUE)), .by = lag) |>
    pivot_longer(-lag, names_to = "interval", values_to = "coverage") |>
    mutate(nominal = as.numeric(str_remove(interval, "cover_")) / 100,
           interval = paste0(nominal * 100, "% interval"))

ggplot(coverage, aes(x = lag, y = coverage)) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = nominal), linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray50") +
    geom_line(colour = version_colours[["nowcast"]], linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(colour = version_colours[["nowcast"]], size = 2.5) +
    facet_wrap(~interval) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_percent(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
    labs(x = glue("Lag from cutoff ({lag_unit})"), y = "Empirical coverage", title = "Interval coverage by lag")
```

```{r}
#| label: guide-section-flag
#| include: false
lift_text <- if (has_guide) "" else "No guiding indicator was given, so the correlation lift is not computed."
```

## Correlation lift against `r if (has_guide) guiding_name else "a guiding indicator"` {#lift}

`r lift_text`

```{r}
#| label: lift-data
#| eval: !expr has_guide
#| output: asis
guide_rows <- cached("guide", epidata_snapshot(params$guiding_source, params$guiding_signal, params$geo_type))
guide_final <- final_values_from_snapshot(guide_rows, params$truth_buffer_days) |>
    mutate(reference_time = week_end_date(reference_time))

candidates <- nowcasts |>
    filter(quantile_level == 0.5) |>
    select(forecast_date, cutoff, report_time, geo_value, reference_time, lag, nowcast = value) |>
    left_join(as_of, by = c("forecast_date", "cutoff", "geo_value", "reference_time", "lag")) |>
    apply_exclusions(exclusions, params$geo_type)
pairs <- build_lift_pairs(candidates, guide_final, params$correlation_lags_weeks)

cat(glue(
    "- **Guide**: finalized {guiding_name}, weeks up to {max(guide_final$reference_time)}.\n",
    "- **Pairs**: {label_comma()(nrow(pairs))} (forecast date, geo, lag) rows with a nowcast, an as-of value and the guide.\n"
))
```

For each cutoff, the anchor is the Saturday that ends the latest full epiweek.
The guide is its finalized value for the anchor week.
At lag *k*, the candidate is the value for the week that ends *k* weeks before the anchor: once from the nowcast median and once from the as-of data at the same cutoff.
`r if (!weekly) "The candidate is a daily 7-day average, so only its Saturday values are used: each covers exactly one epiweek."`
The correlations are Spearman correlations, and Δ is nowcast minus as-of.
At lags past the revision window, the nowcast and the as-of value agree, so Δ should go to 0.

### Per geo, over time

For each geo and lag, the correlation over forecast dates between the candidate and the guide (geos with at least `r params$min_points_per_geo` forecast dates).

```{r}
#| label: lift-by-geo
#| eval: !expr has_guide
#| fig-height: 4.5
lift_geo <- lift_by_geo(pairs, params$min_points_per_geo)

lift_geo |>
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(lag_weeks), y = delta_cor)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray50") +
    geom_boxplot(fill = version_colours[["nowcast"]], alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.5, colour = version_colours[["nowcast"]]) +
    labs(x = "Lag (weeks before the anchor week)", y = "Δ Spearman (nowcast − as-of)",
         title = "Correlation gain of the nowcast, per geo",
         subtitle = glue("Against finalized {guiding_name}; one point per geo"))
```

```{r}
#| label: lift-by-geo-table
#| eval: !expr has_guide
nowcast_lag_by_week <- pairs |> distinct(lag_weeks, lag) |>
    summarize(nowcast_lag = paste(sort(lag), collapse = ", "), .by = lag_weeks)
lift_geo |>
    summarize(
        geos = n(),
        median_cor_nowcast = median(cor_nowcast),
        median_cor_as_of = median(cor_as_of),
        median_delta = median(delta_cor),
        share_improved = mean(delta_cor > 0),
        .by = lag_weeks
    ) |>
    left_join(nowcast_lag_by_week, by = "lag_weeks") |>
    relocate(nowcast_lag, .after = lag_weeks) |>
    arrange(lag_weeks) |>
    mutate(across(starts_with("median"), \(xx) round(xx, 3)), share_improved = label_percent(1)(share_improved)) |>
    DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, caption = glue("nowcast_lag: the matching lag of the WIS section, in {lag_unit}"),
                  options = list(dom = "t", ordering = FALSE))
```

```{r}
#| label: lift-example
#| eval: !expr has_guide
#| fig-height: 7
example_pairs <- pairs |>
    filter(lag_weeks == min(params$correlation_lags_weeks), geo_value %in% overview_geos) |>
    pivot_longer(c(nowcast, as_of_value, guide), names_to = "series", values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(
        series = recode(series, as_of_value = "as_of", guide = "final"),
        value = value / max(value, na.rm = TRUE),
        .by = c(geo_value, series)
    ) |>
    tidyr::complete(anchor = latest_saturday(cutoffs$cutoff), geo_value, series)

ggplot(example_pairs, aes(x = anchor, y = value, colour = series, linetype = series)) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~geo_value, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = version_colours, labels = c(version_labels[c("nowcast", "as_of")], final = guiding_name),
                        name = NULL) +
    scale_linetype_manual(values = c(nowcast = "solid", as_of = "solid", final = "dashed"),
                          labels = c(version_labels[c("nowcast", "as_of")], final = guiding_name), name = NULL) +
    scale_x_date(breaks = breaks_pretty(), labels = label_date_short()) +
    labs(x = "Anchor week (ending)", y = "Scaled to each series' maximum",
         title = glue("Lag {min(params$correlation_lags_weeks)}: candidate and guide by anchor week"))
```

### Across geos, at each forecast date

The RAT-scan real-time view: at each forecast date, the correlation across geos (at least 5) between the candidate and the guide.
This measures whether the geos rank the same way, which a nowcast changes less than it changes the trend within a geo.
When one indicator is a count and the other a percentage, the ranks across geos mostly follow population, so read this view with care.

```{r}
#| label: lift-by-date
#| eval: !expr has_guide
#| fig-height: 5
lift_date <- lift_by_date(pairs)

lift_date |>
    pivot_longer(c(cor_nowcast, cor_as_of), names_to = "series", values_to = "cor") |>
    mutate(series = recode(series, cor_nowcast = "nowcast", cor_as_of = "as_of")) |>
    complete_dates(lag_weeks = params$correlation_lags_weeks, series = c("nowcast", "as_of")) |>
    mutate(lag_weeks = paste("Lag", lag_weeks, "weeks")) |>
    ggplot(aes(x = forecast_date, y = cor, colour = series)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "gray50") +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
    facet_wrap(~lag_weeks) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = version_colours, labels = version_labels, name = NULL) +
    scale_x_date(breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 4), labels = label_date_short()) +
    labs(x = "Forecast date", y = "Spearman across geos", title = "Cross-geo correlation with the guide")
```

```{r}
#| label: lift-by-date-table
#| eval: !expr has_guide
lift_date |>
    summarize(dates = n(), median_delta = round(median(delta_cor), 3),
              share_improved = label_percent(1)(mean(delta_cor > 0)), .by = lag_weeks) |>
    arrange(lag_weeks) |>
    DT::datatable(rownames = FALSE, options = list(dom = "t", ordering = FALSE))
```

## Method notes {#methods}

- **Cutoffs.** A forecast date is a Wednesday. Its cutoff is `r report_offset_days` day(s) from it. Only runs whose report date is the cutoff are used, so the nowcast and the as-of value use the same release.
- **Lags** are counted from the cutoff, in `r lag_unit`. Weekly nowcasts label a week by an inner day; this notebook moves the label to the Saturday that ends the epiweek, the V5 convention.
- **As-of value.** The latest value at the cutoff. A reference time with no value yet gets the latest earlier value of its geo, up to `r max_fill_days` days back.
- **Truth.** The latest value of the nowcast signal. Reference times within `r params$truth_buffer_days` days of the latest version are not scored, because they may still be revised. This is stricter than the model's `ref_lag` (`r ref_lag` days), which deliberately ignores the rare late revisions.
- **Exclusions.** Rows in a training exclusion window of the artifact are dropped from the scores and from the correlation pairs.
